title: Phobos lenders data pack

priority.description: Override files only: files apply lowest first (default 0), so a higher number has a later word. Leave it out unless you need it.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.
Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

name.description: The name shown in the app and on the ledger (the creditor): 1 to 40 characters, without | , = # [ ] < >.

pitch.description: The lender's own words to a customer, in their sales voice; at most 400 characters, no placeholders.

accredited.description: A registered lender (lower rates, asks for standing) or a quick-money one.

home.description: The story place the lender trades from (a key of Framework places): a regional place lends in its region, a part of one only to a player docked there.

person.description: The story person who speaks for the lender; optional.

requires.description: Who may borrow: a story requires block, checked as story content is (see the story schema).

ratePerShift.description: Interest per shift on the balance still owed, as a share (0.0003 is 0.03%).

maxPrincipal.description: The most the player may owe this lender at once, in credits; above minPrincipal.

maxLoans.description: How many loans from this lender may run at once (default 1).

offers.description: What it lends for: cash, ship (a ship broker purchase) or home (an apartment from a real-estate broker).

minDownShare.description: For ship and home loans: the least paid down, as a share of the price (default 0.5).

lenders.description: Lenders by id (lowercase words joined by dashes, at most 32 characters).

description: Phobos Banking lenders pack: who lends where, to whom and on what terms. Terms are copied into a loan when it is taken.
